# Subway Seat for Zed

All three flavors in one extension: crust title and status bars, espresso panels, a walnut editor and lifted menus. The agent panel's diffs, borders and hovers are tuned too.

[Zed](https://zed.dev) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/zed/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`themes/subway-seat.json`](themes/subway-seat.json) | ~/.config/zed/themes/subway-seat.json |
| All three | [`extension.toml`](extension.toml) | packaged in the extension |
| All three | [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | packaged in the extension |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Zed's extensions page (or copy the theme to ~/.config/zed/themes/), then settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Zed's extensions page (or copy the theme to ~/.config/zed/themes/), then settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Zed's extensions page (or copy the theme to ~/.config/zed/themes/), then settings.json:

```json
"theme": "Subway Seat Enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
